name: Distillates (petroleum), steam-cracked, C8-12 fraction, polymd., distn. lights; Low boiling point naphtha - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained by distillation of the polymerized C8 through C12 fraction from steam-cracked petroleum distillates.  It consists predominantly of aromatic hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C8 through C12.]
